leaks.title: Direct-to-DM Traffic Drop-Off

leaks.title: Post-Call Revenue Leak

sequences.title: Why Coaches Lose Leads After 1st Interaction
sequences.emailSubject: The #1 reason 85% of your coaching inquiries never book a call
sequences.emailBody:
Hey {{name}},

Yesterday you checked your funnel health score ({{score}}/100).

Here is a harsh reality of high-ticket coaching:

When a prospect lands on your profile or website, only 3% to 5% are ready to buy TODAY. The other 95% are interested, but they need trust, proof, and consistency.

If your only call-to-action is "DM me" or "Book a call", 95% of your traffic bounces and NEVER comes back.

That means you are paying with your time (and ads) to warm up leads for your competitors.

Tomorrow, I'll show you the exact 7-Step Acquisition Funnel we use to nurture the "not-ready-today" leads automatically until they book.

Talk soon,
Mohammad Galib Khan

sequences.title: Anatomy of an Automated Nurture Funnel
sequences.emailSubject: Case Study: How Julian added $30k/mo with zero extra ad spend
sequences.emailBody:
Hey {{name}},

Instead of chasing people in Instagram or LinkedIn DMs for 3 hours every day, what if your client acquisition ran like clockwork?

Here is the breakdown of Julian's system (B2B Sales Coach):
1. High-Value Diagnostic Lead Magnet (Filters qualified prospects)
2. Automated Qualification Gate (Filters out low budget inquiries)
3. Day 0-7 Pre-Call Indoctrination (Educates before the call)
4. Automated SMS Reminders (Boosted show-up rate from 55% to 92%)

Result: 6 extra high-ticket clients in 45 days.

Ready to see what this would look like mapped out for your {{offer}}?

👉 Book your 1-on-1 Strategy Session: {{bookingUrl}}

sequences.title: The Real Math Behind Systematic Follow-Up
sequences.emailSubject: The economics of 3 extra clients per month (Math inside)
sequences.emailBody:
Hey {{name}},

Let's look at simple unit economics for your coaching business:

• Your average offer price: ${{offerPrice}}
• If our acquisition system helps you convert just 3 additional clients each month:
→ That is ${{tripleClientRevenue}} in monthly revenue (${{yearlyClientRevenue}} per year).

Notice that you don't need 100,000 followers or complex 40-step funnels.
You just need a tight system: Attract → Capture → Nurture → Qualify → Book → Follow Up → Convert.

Let's build your machine.

👉 Pick a time on our calendar: {{bookingUrl}}
